Hi Jens, nothing has changed since we spoke on November 15. Order Shop···· is paid but hasn't shipped yet. Your Hammer Miner Thor P2 ships November 30, 2026, and the Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA comes in the same box.

The P2 is waiting for the next batch of stock to reach our Netherlands warehouse. Because it ships from inside the EU, you won't pay any import VAT or duty when it arrives. You can follow that batch at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status, and we'll email you tracking as soon as your order ships.
